sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics in Tetra Blocks are simple yet challenging to master. As mentioned earlier, your primary objective is to create complete lines of Tetra blocks without any gaps. The game features seven different shapes, each with its unique rotation patterns and movement speeds. The shapes include the I-Block, J-Block, L-Block, O-Block, S-Block, T-Block, and Z-Block.

To create complete lines, you need to rotate and move the blocks strategically. The game requires a combination of spatial reasoning and quick reflexes, as you need to think several steps ahead and anticipate the blocks' movements. As you progress through the levels, the difficulty level increases rapidly, and the blocks fall at an astonishing speed. This forces you to think faster and make more precise decisions to succeed.

The game also features a scoring system that rewards players for creating complete lines, combos, and clearing the board quickly. The scoring system adds a new layer of complexity to the game, as you need to balance your strategy with the need to score points. sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:
If you're new to Tetra Blocks, here are some beginner tips and tricks to help you get started:

1. Start with the I-Block, as it's the easiest shape to work with. The I-Block can be rotated in any direction, making it perfect for beginners.
2. Focus on creating complete lines, as this will earn you the most points. Try to clear the board as quickly as possible to progress to the next level.
3. Use the L-Block and J-Block to create L-Shapes and J-Shapes, as these are essential for creating complete lines.
4. Pay attention to the blocks' movements and rotation patterns, as this will help you anticipate what's coming next.
5. Don't be afraid to experiment and try new things. Tetra Blocks is a game that requires practice and patience to master.

sections.heading: Advanced Strategies
sections.body:
Once you've mastered the basics, it's time to move on to more advanced strategies. Here are some tips to help you improve your gameplay:

1. Focus on creating combos, as this will earn you the most points. Try to clear the board as quickly as possible to progress to the next level.
2. Use the T-Block and S-Block to create T-Shapes and S-Shapes, as these are essential for creating complete lines.
3. Pay attention to the blocks' movements and rotation patterns, as this will help you anticipate what's coming next.
4. Use the blocks' rotation patterns to your advantage, as this will help you create complete lines and combos.
5. Experiment with different block combinations to find what works best for you.
